tagline: Composable Credit infra for any DeFi

key_contracts.AccountManager: Single entry point for margin accounts: create_account, deposit_collateral_tokens, borrow, repay, liquidate
key_contracts.SmartAccount: Dedicated isolated smart contract per user; executes composable calls to external protocols without shared state
key_contracts.LendingPoolXLM: Native pool for XLM deposits, borrow draws, and vXLM mint/redemption
key_contracts.LendingPoolUSDC: Native pool for USDC deposits, borrow draws, and vUSDC mint/redemption
key_contracts.RiskEngine: Stateless health checker enforcing borrow/withdraw gates and collateral valuation
key_contracts.RateModel: Computes per-second borrow rates as a polynomial function of pool utilization
key_contracts.vTokens: Fungible yield-accruing tokens (vXLM, vUSDC) representing LP pool shares
key_contracts.TrackingTokens: Tracks external protocol positions (Blend b-tokens, Aquarius/Soroswap LP tokens) per account
key_contracts.Registry: On-chain address book for dynamic contract resolution
key_contracts.Mercury: Indexer for real-time contract events and historical liquidations

for_lps.mechanism: Deposit assets (XLM, USDC) into lending pools, receive vTokens, earn passive yield from continuous borrower interest + shared liquidation penalties
for_lps.rate_dynamics: Supply APY adjusts dynamically via polynomial utilization curve; higher borrow demand increases APY automatically

for_traders.mechanism: Deposit collateral (XLM or USDC) to borrow up to 10x leverage
for_traders.isolation: Capital remains inside the dedicated on-chain smart account; no cross-account contamination
for_traders.composability: Deploy borrowed funds into external DeFi strategies (Blend lending, Aquarius liquidity pools, Soroswap swaps)

risk_engine_parameters.health_factor_formula: Total Collateral Value / Total Debt Value
risk_engine_parameters.liquidation_mechanism: Permissionless liquidate() calls via AccountManager when HF <= 1.1x; penalty shared between liquidator and lending pool

tier_a_quotable: Dedicated smart account sandboxes per user
Deployable composably to Blend, Aquarius, Soroswap on Stellar Soroban
tier_c_future_or_prohibited: NO mainnet claims (currently on Stellar Testnet only)
NO token launch or TVL claims (pre-mainnet, zero production TVL)
NO audit completion claims until formal audit reports are published
